title: Disproportionality and Temporal Analysis of Australian Antivenoms, Tropical Medicines and Japanese Encephalitis Vaccine in the TGA DAEN — Analysis Code
description: Reproducibility code for pre-registered, READUS-PV 2024-compliant analyses of the TGA Database of Adverse Event Notifications (DAEN). (1) Disproportionality analysis of Australian antivenoms (8 products) and a tropical-medicine basket (7 products): data acquisition, cleaning, PRR/ROR/IC/EBGM computation, drug-role stratification, sensitivity analyses, and clinical face-validity review. (2) Within-product temporal analysis of Japanese encephalitis (JEV) vaccine adverse event reports around the 2022 Australian outbreak: PELT change-point detection, Poisson, quasi-Poisson and negative-binomial structural-break models, per-quarter Preferred-Term reporting rates, post-2022 sub-period composition (administrative vaccination errors vs classical reactions), and the scripts that generate the JEV paper's figures. Aggregate JEV output tables and figures are included; raw DAEN exports are not redistributed.
